source: https://console.cloud.google.com/agent-platform/publishers/google/model-garden/gemini-robotics-er-2-preview-info (workbook ID 148, read in Chrome 2026-10-06, Overview tab; no raw file saved)

modelDetails.type: Vision-language embodied reasoning model for robotics
modelDetails.architecture: Inputs: text, image, video and audio (interleaving possible); output: text; input token limit 128k, output token limit 64k
modelDetails.description: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is a vision-language model that lets robots perceive and interact with the physical world, acting as a high-level brain that plans multi-step tasks and hands motor execution to a lower-level vision-language-action model.

intendedUse.primaryIntendedUseCases: Agentic orchestration of robots, for example using vision-language-action models; robot video understanding including progress understanding and success detection; instrument reading; pointing and spatial reasoning; task orchestration with custom robot APIs for long-horizon tasks

factors.software: Google Gen AI SDK for Python, Go, JavaScript, Java and .NET; the Agent Platform API must be enabled

ethicalConsiderations.riskFactors: Generative AI models can make mistakes, and physical robots can cause damage
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built with safety in mind; the Google DeepMind robotics safety page gives more information
ethicalConsiderations.limitations: A Pre-GA offering available as is with possibly limited support; Private Preview access requires the project to be allowlisted by the Google team

modelCardContent.caveatsAndRecommendations: It is the user's responsibility to maintain a safe environment around the robot; review the Google DeepMind robotics safety page
